text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Look this way, please~
—Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: All right, let me check!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've come with Fine Motion to shoot an advertisement for a photo studio.
The theme is an outdoor wedding photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They said the next shoot is in the forest.
Hehe, a forest wedding sounds so lovely, doesn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It looks like preparations will take some time.
Why don't we go ahead and take a little stroll?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the air is so nice! The greenery is gorgeous too—it reminds me of the forests back home in Ireland!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if, by continuing to walk like this, I might find a fairy door
that connects straight back to my homeland?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Flicker, flicker)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I mentioned seeing a mysterious light beside Fine Motion out of nowhere.
Was it just my imagination...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A light? I didn't see anything, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah... hehe.
That must be the fairies playing a trick♪
choice_data_list: No way... There's no such thing as fairies, right...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows?
I mean, it's such a gorgeous forest!
Wouldn't it make sense if fairies lived here?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fairies just love places with beautiful water and trees.
Ireland has tons of legends about fairies like that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Helping with chores in the dead of night,
or revealing where gold lies hidden.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Though some of them are mischievous fairies who'll occasionally whisk people away, so they say♪"
choice_data_list: We can't let Fine get taken away.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't worry, Trainer.
It's not like anyone's gonna kidnap me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I like to think I'm quite good at negotiating, you know. Even if a mischievous fairy were to appear—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I shall show utmost courtesy and ask them
to lend a hand in the development of Ireland♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You see, if the light
you saw was a real fairy, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the job after this
is going to be simply wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion-saaan, you're up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeees♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the photoshoot in the forest went smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Alright, checking the data now!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh, what!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it's just the lighting, but Fine Motion-san
seems to be sparkling all around..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Were you able to take some nice photos?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's magnificent! A shot like this... it's practically a miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion, draped in an ethereal light.
The poster shot on this day became
the talk of the town for quite some time!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
That expression is wonderful...!
Hold that for a second—wait, huh? No way!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
The shutter won't click?!
Why now~? Just when it was getting good~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I wonder.
I'm not sure, but maybe we should try scolding them just in case?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't get in everyone's way.
If you take your pranks too far,
I might just have to spray you with water, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion spoke to those around her in a theatrical manner. Thanks to that, the equipment trouble was resolved before long.
